slides.title: HSA or FSA money left?
Can I use my card here?
items: Yes. Imaging is a qualified medical expense.
Pay with your HSA or FSA card at your visit.
Need a receipt? We give you an itemized one with CPT codes.
Self-pay? No referral and no prior authorization.
slides.footnote: Source: IRS Publications 502 and 969. Your plan's rules apply. Referral-free for eligible self-pay exams.

slides.title: FSA? Check your deadline.
items: Many FSAs are use-it-or-lose-it by the plan year's end.
Some plans allow a grace period or carryover.
Ask your plan for your exact date and balance.
Have a scan your doctor ordered? Plan it before then.
slides.footnote: Source: IRS Publication 969. Employers choose a grace period or a carryover, not both. HSA money doesn't expire.

Quick answers:
✔️ Diagnostic imaging is a qualified medical expense (IRS Publication 502)
✔️ Pay with your HSA or FSA card at your visit
✔️ Need it for your records or reimbursement? We give you an itemized receipt with CPT codes
✔️ Self-pay means no referral and no waiting on prior authorization for eligible exams

Have an FSA? Many are use-it-or-lose-it at the end of the plan year. Some plans add a grace period or let a small amount carry over, so ask your plan for your exact date and balance. HSA money doesn't expire.

Have insurance too? Ask your plan whether a self-pay scan counts toward your deductible and what you'd owe through the plan. We'll check your benefits for free.

facts_checked: Checked 2026-11-03. IRS Publication 502 (medical expenses include diagnostic tests and X-rays) and Publication 969 (HSA funds roll over; health FSA use-or-lose with optional grace period up to 2.5 months or carryover, not both): irs.gov pages confirmed by search but the page fetch was blocked this run, so wording kept general and matches the website's own FAQ. Practice facts from amiweb origin/main a595390: prices.ts (mri $295, mriContrast $395, ct $295, ctContrast $395 Seminole, ultrasound $195 Seminole, dexa $75 Seminole); mri-cost-florida/page.tsx (HSA/FSA accepted, 'Diagnostic imaging is a qualified medical expense'); pricing/page.tsx (reading included, no hidden fees, itemized receipt with CPT codes, no referral for self-pay, insurance needs physician's order, free benefits check); services-data.ts ('Eligible self-pay exams do not need a referral').
